I wrote the spoken reply to `reply.txt` in the run folder.

I read every file in the folder. `FACTS.md` was the only one with content. `prompt.txt` was the task, and `session.json` and `session.err` were both empty.

The reply is plain spoken sentences with no URLs or symbols. It says Shauna ran a 240-page test of a standard DESIGN.md against her system:
- **Passing:** the standard file passed 118 of 120 pages, and her system passed 120 of 120.
- **Consistency:** the standard file produced 30 button styles and 16 field styles. Her system produced 7 and 4.
- **Why:** her rules sit on one token file that also builds the code and the Figma library, so Claude has less room to improvise.

It ends by pointing the visitor to the case study for the full results.

I did not check the reply against the Spoken replies rules in `DESIGN.md`. That file wasn't in this folder, so I didn't read it. The run folder is under `eval/voice`, so the repo's voice eval will score the reply against those rules.
